one_liner: Pitchers threw Cal Raleigh into the rulebook zone just 46 percent of the time -- the eleventh-lowest rate in this 485-batter pull.
three_things: 46 percent zone rate: he was pitched around like a middle-of-the-order threat.
He still produced 896 batted balls from 2,813 pitches.
Contact quality of .372 estimated wOBA, with a 105.8 mph 90th percentile.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). The contact numbers -- exit velocity and estimated wOBA on contact -- cover the batted balls only, not every pitch seen, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. League-wide ranks were computed by sorting all 485 batters in this manifest on the named field; every printed value is read verbatim.
